pages.setting: Windmill harbor beside the royal greenhouse and a warehouse
pages.mainAction: The guardian presents a tiny seed box as the child reaches for it, while a huge puff erupts behind the warehouse.
pages.lighting: Bright harbor daylight with a warm glow from the golden seed

pages.setting: Harbor airspace around a windmill and warehouse
pages.mainAction: The kite-boat launches and circles a windmill as the child grips both colored handles and a chicken waves below.
continuityAnchors: tiny seed box carried from the greenhouse
blue wing handle and red tail handle

pages.setting: Air above the harbor among flying laundry
pages.mainAction: Tangled in a flying laundry basket, the child passes the red handle to the companion, whose head emerges through an upside-down shirt.
pages.lighting: Bright daylight with fluttering fabric shadows
continuityAnchors: seed box secured in padded pocket
child holding both colored handles before the handoff

pages.setting: Orchard of round clouds hanging from silver branches
pages.mainAction: Working separate handles, the pair steer smoothly between puffing clouds as gray weather gathers ahead.
pages.lighting: Soft pearly daylight fading toward storm gray

pages.setting: Soft cloud canopy inside the cloud orchard
pages.mainAction: The kite-boat lies buried in a sagging cloud while the companion spots a small cloud rolling its pink underside upward.
pages.lighting: Muted storm light with a soft pink cloud glow
continuityAnchors: kite-boat mast protruding from the cloud

pages.setting: Deep valley of floating pools and upward-flowing rain
pages.mainAction: The kite-boat springs free of the orchard and is lifted above the valley by a rising stream of silver raindrops.
pages.lighting: Cool silver daylight beneath layered clouds
continuityAnchors: same kite-boat emerging from the cloud orchard

pages.setting: Among thick and curling upward rain currents
pages.mainAction: A tiny green leaf breaks from the glowing seed box as the child closes its shutters and the companion indicates a thin curling current.
pages.lighting: Silver rain light pulsing with warm gold from the box
continuityAnchors: kite-boat carried upward by reverse rain
child on wing control and companion on tail control

pages.setting: Edge of the reverse-rain valley above a sea of mist
pages.mainAction: After spiraling out of the rain, the kite-boat settles onto the mist as the tiny leaf retracts and deep blue night descends.
pages.lighting: Silver dusk shifting abruptly into deep sparkling blue
continuityAnchors: thin curling rain currents receding behind

pages.setting: Deep blue night above the sea of mist
pages.mainAction: The kite-boat joins luminous migrating creatures as their lights extinguish in sequence, leaving the pair as dark silhouettes.
pages.lighting: Blue darkness fading from many colored glows toward black
continuityAnchors: round creature perched on the mast

pages.setting: Lightless sky above the sea of mist
pages.mainAction: In near-total darkness, the silhouetted pair tap their separate handles and brace together as the mast creature extinguishes its last light.
pages.lighting: Near-black with one final pinprick of fading creature light
continuityAnchors: round creature remains on the mast

pages.setting: Sky above the mist facing a completely frozen island
pages.mainAction: An upward gust lifts the kite-boat into relit creatures, revealing the white island and two opposing winds circling its shore.
pages.lighting: Cold dawn glow with returning creature lights and a golden box shimmer
continuityAnchors: island trees, houses, and waves frozen solid

pages.setting: Inside the opposing winds around the frozen island
pages.mainAction: The rolling kite-boat is pulled between opposing winds as the companion studies rising square flakes and diving round flakes.
pages.lighting: Cold white storm light punctuated by rapid golden pulses
continuityAnchors: same kite-boat at the island barrier

pages.mainAction: The pair rapidly alternate wing and tail adjustments while a double gust strains the handles in opposite directions near the shore.
pages.lighting: Harsh white snow glare with warm flashes from the seed box

pages.setting: Snow wall at the center of the island wind barrier
pages.mainAction: Taking quick turns with the two winds, the pair synchronize on a half-square, half-round flake and dive through the snow wall onto the island.
pages.lighting: Blinding storm white opening onto calm pale island light

pages.setting: Frozen island square around a small crack in the ground
pages.mainAction: The planted golden seed erupts into a giant warm-breathing flower, thawing the square as playful winds toss hats and a snowman into tulips.
pages.lighting: Warm golden bloom light spreading through icy blue surroundings
continuityAnchors: frozen trees and rooftops beginning to thaw

pages.setting: Thawing island beach beneath a pink, gold, and blue sky
pages.mainAction: With ribbons tied to its wings, the kite-boat lifts gently from the beach celebration and flies toward the changing sky.
pages.lighting: Warm celebratory sunset blending pink, gold, and blue
continuityAnchors: ribbons tied to the kite-boat wings
